tools.name: get_signed_reserves
tools.description: The latest signed proof of reserves for kUSD, the Kerne stablecoin on Base: outstanding kUSD, the USDC held in each PSM contract, the solvency ratio, skUSD share price and the hedge account, all read on chain at one pinned block and signed every 15 minutes by a dedicated key that holds no funds. tools.name: get_stock_quote
tools.description: The latest signed REFERENCE quote for a one week covered call on TSLAc (Coinbase tokenized Tesla stock on Base): spot from the Chainlink feed, realized volatility, strike near 20 delta, premium in basis points, expiry, and how long the quote is valid. A pricing agent signs a new one every 15 minutes

tools.name: verify_stock_quote
tools.description: Checks a Kerne stock quote: that the hash matches the signed string, that both signatures (EIP-191 over the document, EIP-712 over the on-chain Quote struct) recover to the published quote signer, whether the quote has expired, and whether the price round it is bound to is still the latest round on

tools.name: get_vault_state
tools.description: The current on-chain state of the Kerne covered call vault for TSLAc on Base, read live in one call pinned to one block: epoch number, whether an epoch is live, whether sales are paused, deposit cap, total assets, the limits the vault enforces on any call it writes, the keeper, and the latest price

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_stock_quote, verify_stock_quote, get_vault_state · Private data: verify_stock_quote, get_vault_state · Public sink: get_signed_reserves.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_stock_quote, verify_stock_quote, get_vault_state · Private data: verify_stock_quote, get_vault_state · Public sink: get_signed_reserves

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
